requirement.summary: Creating a Transfer reserves only exact source funds and rejects every published money, account and currency boundary without durable effect.
Settlement commits one balanced Posting, balances, reservation, event and chronologically replayable Statement legs atomically.
Cancellation releases a pending reservation once, while Reversal appends one exact compensating Posting without rewriting history.
The FINAL request union accepts one to twenty ordered unique destination legs with a stepwise safe sum and exact legacy discriminator.
Multi-leg settlement and reversal expose ordered stable linkage and every ledger leg appears atomically across detail, statements and snapshot.
Public accounts, Transfers, Postings and Statements independently reconcile currency conservation, pending reservations and integer balances.
Concurrent and unknown-response mutation replay survives API restart with its original status, semantic body and single durable effect.
Settlement and cancellation have one final authority at each public barrier boundary and cannot double-release or half-post funds.
Concurrent Reversal and duplicate settlement delivery leave at most one original Posting and one compensating Posting with contiguous events.
Concurrent multi-leg Transfers sharing funds and destinations finish without deadlock and preserve all-or-none ordered ledger effects.
A claimed Settlement lease survives SIGKILL, is reclaimed after expiry and fences every stale commit token.
SIGKILL at effect-complete and before-commit never exposes a partial one- or multi-leg Posting and replacement commits exactly once.
Transactionally committed Domain Events retry an unknown webhook acknowledgement with stable identity, headers, body and aggregate order.
Multiple workers claim eligible Settlement Tasks by createdAt then transferId and drain lease failures without starvation or duplication.
Production Chromium completes the one-leg create, settle, cancel, reverse and Statement workflow using visible public-API-backed controls.
Production Chromium edits ordered beneficiary legs and visibly distinguishes validation, insufficient funds, atomic success and Reversal.
OpenAPI and the FINAL point-in-time snapshot publish exact conditional Transfer, Posting, Work and Event wires with stable sorting and secret omission.
Every public Transfer identifier, amount, leg order, timestamp and sequence traces consistently through Work, Posting, Statements, Events and snapshot.

requirement.summary: Current transfer postings, statements and replay survive FINAL restart. Exercise only the current public API and legal seed on one FINAL submission; verify durable business state, identity and replay without historical binary, old database or synthetic migration-only wrappers.
The exact 64-client statement-read workload sustains 150 complete responses per second at p95 at most 150 ms and preserves ledger invariants.
The exact CREATE, CREATE, CANCEL, REVERSE mutation workload sustains 40 successes per second at p95 at most 500 ms with disjoint identities.
Two replacement workers drain exactly two thousand killed-and-expired Settlement Tasks in at most 45 seconds with one Posting per Transfer.
